description: Evidence matrix, GO/annotation decision table, and the consolidated summary figure for the ARHGAP23 PDZ ligand-class assessment
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, os
pd.set_option("display.width",250); pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth",60)

EV=[
 dict(id="E1",citation="PMID 36115835 (Gogl 2022, Nat Commun) via IntAct",evidence_type="direct experimental, holdup affinity assay",
   stance="supports (class I) / refutes (canonical)",claim_tested="ARHGAP23 PDZ ligand class",
   key_finding="19/19 mappable measured binders carry S/T at P-2 (class I); 15/19 acidic at P-3. Fisher p=0.0028 vs 71% class I background; P-3 acidic OR 6.56, p=3.5e-4",
   context="human PDZ domain construct vs human/viral C-terminal peptide library, in vitro",
   confidence="high for class, moderate for affinity",limitation="n=19 above-threshold binders only; affinities not in IntAct deposition; background is union of 5 baits' binders, not the full library"),
 dict(id="E2",citation="this work, UniProt Q9P227 + CDD cd06756 + Pfam PF17820 + InterPro",evidence_type="computational, sequence",
   stance="qualifies",claim_tested="PDZ domain boundary and carboxylate-binding loop",
   key_finding="GPhiGPhi loop is G53-F54-G55-F56 with Lys48 at the PSD-95 Arg318 position, 15-23 residues N-terminal to the PROSITE/UniProt PDZ start at 71; InterPro IPR001478 gives 52-155, SSF50156 gives 19-156",
   context="human sequence annotation",confidence="high",limitation="boundary call rests on alignment to PSD-95 PDZ3 and on the CDD/SUPFAM models, not on an ARHGAP23 structure"),
 dict(id="E3",citation="this work, PDB 1BE9 + AlphaFold DB AF-Q9P227-F1-v6",evidence_type="computational, structural",
   stance="supports",claim_tested="alphaB1 identity and groove integrity",
   key_finding="alphaB1 is Tyr133 by three independent methods (NW alignment, betaC-betaD Gly-Asp anchor, Kabsch superposition 1.66 A CA RMSD over 43 anchors). Transferred CRIPT peptide gives 0 backbone clashes, closest backbone contact 3.07 A; Tyr133 OH 2.48 A from P-2 Thr OG1 vs 2.59 A for PSD-95 His372 NE2",
   context="AlphaFold model, pLDDT 85 at Tyr133, 87.2 across alphaB",confidence="moderate-high",limitation="apo model; side-chain rotamers unreliable, hence backbone-only clash criterion"),
 dict(id="E4",citation="PDB 2YUY (RIKEN structural genomics)",evidence_type="direct experimental, solution NMR",
   stance="supports",claim_tested="fold and alphaB1 identity in an experimental structure",
   key_finding="20-model NMR structure of ARHGAP21 PDZ (47-159); 1.72 A CA RMSD to PSD-95 PDZ3 over 68 positions; alphaB1 = Tyr98 (UniProt Tyr137); Tyr98 OH within 3.5 A of the transferred P-2 OG1 in 13/20 models",
   context="apo domain, ARHGAP21 paralogue, no ligand",confidence="high for fold, low for docking",limitation="apo ensemble, groove loops imprecise (1.62-2.64 A local RMSD); 1-25 backbone clashes per model, so unusable for quantitative docking"),
 dict(id="E5",citation="this work, UniProt human reviewed proteome",evidence_type="computational, comparative",
   stance="qualifies",claim_tested="how unusual Tyr at alphaB1 is",
   key_finding="275 PDZ instances in 155 reviewed human proteins; 250 confidently aligned. His 131 (52.4%), Tyr 12 (4.8%). The 12 Tyr domains are PDZD2, PDZK1, PDZK1P1, CYTIP, PRX, AHNAK2, DEPTOR, PCLO, RADIL, NOS1, ARHGAP21, ARHGAP23",
   context="whole human PDZome",confidence="high",limitation="depends on UniProt PDZ feature annotation; 25 domains failed to align confidently"),
 dict(id="E6",citation="PMID 8974395 (Songyang 1997, Science)",evidence_type="primary literature, peptide library",
   stance="competing framework",claim_tested="His at alphaB1 defines class I",
   key_finding="PDZ ligand classes I/II/III defined by peptide library selection; a small set of PDZ residues sets specificity",
   context="rat/human PDZ domains, oriented peptide library",confidence="high",limitation="the rule was derived from a limited domain panel and is a heuristic, which E1 shows can fail for ARHGAP23"),
 dict(id="E7",citation="this work, Ensembl/UniProt orthologue set",evidence_type="computational, comparative",
   stance="supports",claim_tested="conservation of the specificity residues",
   key_finding="carboxylate loop GFGFTLRHFIVY invariant in 110/110 vertebrate orthologues; alphaB1 Tyr in 108/110, Phe in two snakes; His never observed",
   context="mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians, teleosts",confidence="high",limitation="orthologue set assembled by sequence similarity, not by synteny"),
 dict(id="E8",citation="PMID 41957357; PMID 38970683; PMID 33547379; PMID 30692208",evidence_type="primary literature, cell biology",
   stance="qualifies",claim_tested="whether reported partners engage the PDZ via a C-terminus",
   key_finding="ARHGAP21 PDZ binds an internal FLNA 1-1200 fragment, not a C-terminus; PKP4 (-DSWV) associates with ARHGAP23 and reduces RhoA binding; WNV NS5 (-DTVL) PBM, ARHGAP21 knockdown lowers replication; Claudin-2 PBM pull-down recovers Arhgap21",
   context="mammalian cells, co-IP and pull-down",confidence="moderate",limitation="none of these map the interaction to the ARHGAP23 PDZ groove by mutagenesis of the groove itself"),
 dict(id="E9",citation="PMID 37305272",evidence_type="computational, prior bioinformatics",
   stance="supports partially",claim_tested="prior analysis of the ArhGAP21/23 PDZ domain",
   key_finding="describes the FTLRxxxVY motif and MAST-family fold similarity; proposes PTEN C-terminus binding by docking only",
   context="in silico",confidence="low-moderate",limitation="docking without experimental validation; does not assign a ligand class"),
 dict(id="E10",citation="this work, IntAct record audit",evidence_type="computational, data provenance",
   stance="qualifies",claim_tested="whether raw partner lists support a class claim",
   key_finding="A proteome-background test gave class I OR 8.54, p=8.6e-84, but this is confounded: 68% of ARHGAP21/23 IntAct records come from one holdup study whose peptide library is itself 71% class I. Using the correct within-dataset null, ARHGAP21 shows no class preference (p=0.69) and only ARHGAP23 remains significant",
   context="562 IntAct records",confidence="high",limitation="illustrates that interactome-wide motif enrichment needs a library-matched null"),
]
E=pd.DataFrame(EV); E.to_csv("evidence_matrix.csv",index=False)
print("=== EVIDENCE MATRIX ===")
print(E[["id","evidence_type","stance","key_finding"]].to_string(index=False)[:2600])

GO=[
 dict(term="GO:0030165 PDZ domain binding",direction="not applicable to ARHGAP23 itself",
      recommendation="do not annotate ARHGAP23 with this term",
      rationale="ARHGAP23 contains a PDZ domain, it is not a PDZ-domain ligand",evidence_code="-"),
 dict(term="GO:0005515 protein binding",direction="supported",recommendation="annotate, IPI, with the holdup partners",
      rationale="19 measured binders in PMID 36115835",evidence_code="IPI (PMID 36115835)"),
 dict(term="GO:0050839 cell adhesion molecule binding",direction="weak",recommendation="do not annotate from this evidence",
      rationale="PKP4/ARVCF/CDH5 associations are not mapped to the PDZ groove",evidence_code="-"),
 dict(term="GO:0005096 GTPase activator activity",direction="supported but separate domain",
      recommendation="keep, attribute to the Rho-GAP domain (905-1097), not the PDZ",
      rationale="domain-level attribution should be explicit in the review",evidence_code="existing"),
 dict(term="free-text: PDZ ligand class",direction="revise",
      recommendation="state: class I S/T-x-Phi binder with a [D/E]-[S/T]-x-Phi preference, mediated by Tyr133 rather than the canonical His at alphaB1",
      rationale="E1 + E3 + E5; the word 'canonical' should be removed",evidence_code="PMID 36115835"),
 dict(term="UniProt feature: PDZ 71-155",direction="revise",
      recommendation="extend the N-terminal boundary to approximately residue 48 so the GPhiGPhi carboxylate-binding loop G53-F54-G55-F56 is inside the domain",
      rationale="E2; the paralogue ARHGAP21 is already annotated 50-159 and does include its GFGF loop",evidence_code="curation lead for UniProt"),
]
G=pd.DataFrame(GO); G.to_csv("go_decision_table.csv",index=False)
print("\n=== GO / ANNOTATION DECISION TABLE ===")
print(G[["term","direction","recommendation"]].to_string(index=False))

# ---------------- final summary figure ----------------
hold=pd.read_csv("holdup_binders_ARHGAP23.csv"); cen=pd.read_csv("human_pdzome_alphaB1_census.csv")
ok=cen[cen.alphaB1_aa.notna() & (cen.aln_score>10)]
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15,4.5))
v=ok.alphaB1_aa.value_counts(); top=v.head(8)
cols=["#C44E52" if a=="Y" else ("#4C72B0" if a=="H" else "#B0B0B0") for a in top.index]
ax[0].bar(top.index,100*top.values/len(ok),color=cols)
ax[0].set_ylabel("% of 250 human PDZ domains"); ax[0].set_xlabel("residue at alphaB1")
ax[0].annotate("ARHGAP23 Tyr133\nARHGAP21 Tyr137\nnNOS Tyr77",xy=(list(top.index).index("Y"),100*v["Y"]/len(ok)),
               xytext=(3.2,32),arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="#C44E52"),fontsize=8.5,color="#C44E52")
ax[0].annotate("canonical class I",xy=(0,100*v["H"]/len(ok)),xytext=(0.6,44),
               arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="#4C72B0"),fontsize=8.5,color="#4C72B0")
ax[0].set_title("ARHGAP23 lacks the class I His\nat the specificity position",fontsize=10)
d=[2.59,2.48,3.37]; lab=["PSD-95 His372 NE2\n1BE9 crystal","ARHGAP23 Tyr133 OH\nAlphaFold v6","ARHGAP21 Tyr98 OH\n2YUY NMR, median"]
ax[1].bar(lab,d,color=["#4C72B0","#DD8452","#C44E52"])
ax[1].axhline(3.5,ls="--",c="grey"); ax[1].text(2.45,3.57,"H-bond cutoff",ha="right",fontsize=8,color="grey")
for i,x in enumerate(d): ax[1].text(i,x+0.06,f"{x:.2f} A",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax[1].set_ylim(0,4.3); ax[1].set_ylabel("distance to P-2 Thr OG1 (A)"); ax[1].tick_params(labelsize=8)
ax[1].set_title("A Tyr hydroxyl reaches the P-2 position\nthat the class I His normally reads",fontsize=10)
cls_counts=hold.ligand_class.value_counts()
ax[2].bar(["class I","class II","class III"],[cls_counts.get("I",0),cls_counts.get("II",0),cls_counts.get("III",0)],
          color=["#4C72B0","#B0B0B0","#B0B0B0"])
ax[2].plot([0,1,2],[0.706*19,0.135*19,0.118*19],"k_",ms=34,mew=2,label="expected from the screened library")
ax[2].legend(fontsize=8); ax[2].set_ylabel("measured ARHGAP23 PDZ binders")
ax[2].set_title("All 19 measured binders are class I\n(PMID 36115835, Fisher p = 0.0028)",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print("\nprovenance files:",sorted(f for f in os.listdir(".") if f.endswith((".csv",".pdb"))))
